Vendored schema resources retain their upstream licenses.

CycloneDX schema resources are from the OWASP CycloneDX specification project.
Copyright OWASP Foundation. Distributed under Apache License 2.0.
Source https://github.com/CycloneDX/specification/tree/1.7.2/schema
bom-1.7.schema.json references cryptography-defs.schema.json. That file was copied
from the cyclonedx-python-lib 11.12.0 wheel, the CycloneDX project's Python library,
where it is cyclonedx/schema/_res/cryptography-defs.SNAPSHOT.schema.json and ships
with the same bom-1.7 schema. It was not compared with the specification repository.

SPDX JSON schema and JSON-LD context resources are generated from the SPDX
Specification 3.0.1 by the SPDX project (SPDX Working Group). The SPDX
Specification is provided under the Community Specification License 1.0
(Community-Spec-1.0); pre-existing portions from copyright holders who have not
contributed under that license are provided under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0
Unported (CC-BY-3.0). LICENSE-SPDX-3.0.1.txt is the specification's license file
at tag 3.0.1, unchanged: https://github.com/spdx/spdx-spec/blob/3.0.1/LICENSE
Source https://spdx.github.io/spdx-spec/v3.0.1/

SOURCES.json records the source of each copied file, the SHA-256 digest of the copy
(sha256) and the SHA-256 digest of the source bytes (sourceSha256). Each copy equals
its source except for one added final newline, so sourceSha256 is the digest of the
copy without its last byte; compare it with the digest of a fresh download of the
source to check a copy. jsf-0.82.schema.json also equals, byte for byte, the copy in
cyclonedx-python-lib 11.12.0. The package checks every copy against sha256 before it
validates an export. These are offline records: they do not authenticate the
upstream publisher. SymBiote validation and projection code is separate from these
third-party schema resources.
